original_text: I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
final_text:
User Story:
As a user, I want to create a personal page with a semi-structured format so that others can easily learn about my background, interests, and skills.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The page includes sections for background, interests, and skills.
- Each section allows for a minimum of 100 characters and a maximum of 500 characters.
- The layout is visually appealing and easy to navigate.

Test Outline:
- Verify that each section is present and meets the character requirements.
- Check the layout for visual appeal and ease of navigation.

original_text: I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner, so that I can earn that designation.
final_text:
User Story:
As a professional seeking certification, I want to complete the application process to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner so that I can enhance my credentials and demonstrate my expertise in Scrum practices.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The application form is fully completed and submitted by the deadline.
- All required documentation is attached to the application.
- Confirmation of application receipt is received within 48 hours.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application form is filled out correctly and submitted on time.
- Check that all necessary documents are included with the application.

original_text: As a Practitioner, I want to include additional details about me in my profile page, so that I can showcase my experience.
final_text:
User Story:
As a Practitioner, I want to add specific details about my professional background and skills to my profile page so that I can effectively showcase my experience and attract potential clients or collaborators.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The profile page allows for the addition of at least three new fields for professional details (e.g., skills, certifications, and work history).
- Users can edit and save their profile information without losing previously entered data.
- The updated profile is displayed correctly on the user’s public profile page.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the new fields are present and functional on the profile edit page.
- Check that changes made to the profile are saved and reflected on the public profile page.

final_text: As a site member, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Trainer, so that I can teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify others.

original_text: As a Trainer, I want to include additional details in my profile page about me, so that others can learn about me and decide if I am the right trainer for them.
final_text:
User Story:
As a Trainer, I want to enhance my profile page with detailed information about my qualifications and experience, so that potential clients can assess my suitability as their trainer.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The profile page includes a section for qualifications and certifications.
- The profile page features a summary of training experience and specialties.
- The profile page allows for client testimonials to be displayed.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the qualifications and certifications section is present and correctly formatted.
- Check that the training experience summary is clear and informative.
- Ensure that client testimonials can be added and displayed on the profile page.
